companyDescription: Immunology biotech · sonelokimab (IL-17A/F Nanobody) · HS BLA submitted Sep 30, 2026 · PsA Phase 3 IZAR-1 met all Week 16 endpoints · cash $537M, runway into mid-2028
priceNote: Live $11.71 (+5.78%, Nov 23 close, Yahoo). Near the bottom of its $9.55–22.16 52-week range, about 27% below the 200-day (~$16.14) and flat vs the 50-day (~$11.59). It has never recovered from the Sep 2025 VELA readout collapse.
summary: A filing-stage biotech whose stock still trades near its post-VELA lows. MoonLake submitted the sonelokimab BLA in hidradenitis suppurativa on Sep 30, 2026 and guides to an FDA filing-acceptance decision by end-November and a PDUFA goal date by mid-December, including whether it gets Priority Review (6 vs 10 months). IZAR-1 in PsA met all Week 16 endpoints (Aug 2026). Cash of $537M funds operations into mid-2028, so this is not a financing story. Targets are wide: H.C. Wainwright $50 (Buy), Leerink $29, Goldman a Sell at $10 (undated). Base +70% assumes acceptance plus Priority Review over 3–6 months, which is above the turbo P75 (21.5%). แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า FDA refuse-to-file ลงได้ 40–50%.

catalysts.name: FDA BLA filing acceptance + Priority Review decision
catalysts.description: MoonLake guided (Nov 4 Q3 release) to an FDA filing-acceptance decision by the end of November 2026 for the sonelokimab HS BLA, including whether it gets Priority Review. A refuse-to-file letter is the binary downside.

catalysts.name: PDUFA goal date disclosed
catalysts.description: Company guides to a PDUFA goal date by mid-December. Priority Review would put action ~6 months from filing (~mid-2027) vs ~10 months (Q3–Q4 2027 launch) under standard review.

catalysts.name: IZAR-2 PsA Week 16 topline
catalysts.description: Second Phase 3 PsA study (enrollment completed Sep 2026); Week 16 topline guided to Q1 2027.

risks: Regulatory binary: a refuse-to-file or a standard (10-month) review would push launch to Q3–Q4 2027; Citi has previously flagged 'significant' regulatory risk.
Competitive HS market: UCB's Bimzelx (IL-17A/F) is already approved in HS, so sonelokimab has to win on dosing or efficacy margin, and the Sep 2025 VELA data disappointed on that comparison.
Analyst dispersion: Goldman's Sell/$10 target (undated) sits below the current price; Leerink $29 vs H.C. Wainwright $50.
IZAR-1 placebo comparisons stay blinded until the Phase 3 program completes, so the PsA efficacy margin is not yet fully visible.
Macro WAIT (15/100) — small-cap biotech beta in a risk-off tape.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00%. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~91% (Nov 23); futures dropped the 50bp tail after the November selloff.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct core CPI +0.3% m/m (hot). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y; Oct PCE (Nov 25) consensus 3.2% is the last inflation print before the Fed.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: A cash-rich filing-stage biotech is less rate-sensitive than pre-revenue tech, but small-cap biotech beta still tracks risk appetite; no financing need before mid-2028 limits dilution risk.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — /macro is WAIT (15/100, high conviction): S&P 7,237 is still below its 200-day (~7,340) after the Nov 23 +4.7% squeeze, VIX 27, breadth ~43% above 50DMA, HY OAS widening to ~3.52%. Turbo prior is unproven in this regime (0/107 windows had SPY down >2%).

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · Moonshot 2% max — filing-stage, runway to mid-2028, ~6 days from the FDA acceptance call. The turbo at-catalyst median is -6.6% (n=76), so Entry 2 ($10.30–11.00) is preferred; a full-size position only after acceptance + Priority Review.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Filing-acceptance events usually move biotechs modestly; the big move comes with Priority Review designation or the PDUFA itself. MLTX rose ~8% into the acceptance deadline (Nov 11).

postWin.note: Verona (VRNA) went from ~$15 at its Jun 2024 Ohtuvayre approval to a $107/ADS Merck takeout in Jul 2025 — the launch-to-M&A moon path. Acceptance alone is typically a smaller +10–25% step.

postLose.note: MLTX itself fell ~89% on the Sep 29, 2025 VELA HS readout. A refuse-to-file would be a smaller but similar shock.

spotSizing.reason: 2%. regulatory_approval sits at +5.8pp vs +7.7pp overall (n=23) — below average but not a ≥2pp tier-2 laggard. Whole-lane weakness and macro WAIT keep size at the floor.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the turbo medianMAE (-20%). Below ~$8.40 the market is pricing a refuse-to-file.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If the BLA is refused or gets only a standard review with no offset, exit.
